ModMetaData.name: HuMilk Co
ModMetaData.author: toaster bath
ModMetaData.description: Adds the ability to use female colonists as livestock for milk. Milking is done by any pawn with an Animals skill of at least 3. The amount of milk a pawn produces depends on the size of her breasts. Uses the Aphrolactone drug to induce lactation in non-mothers.
